article.headline: Minnesota plays New York in non-conference action

article.title: Minnesota plays New York in non-conference action
article.linkText: Minnesota plays New York in non-conference action
article.story: New York Knicks (8-6, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (11-4, third in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Thursday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The New York Knicks take on the Minnesota Timberwolves in cross-conference play. The Timberwolves are 7-2 on their home court. Minnesota has a 1-1 record in games decided by less than 4 points. The Knicks are 4-3 on the road. New York is third in the NBA with 47.5 rebounds per game. Karl-Anthony Towns leads the Knicks with 14.1. The 116.7 points per game the Timberwolves score are 12.8 more points than the Knicks allow (103.9). The Knicks average 14.5 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.7 more made shots on average than the 11.8 per game the Timberwolves give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Jaden McDaniels is shooting 53.0% and averaging 17.1 points for the Timberwolves. LaMelo Ball is averaging 3.8 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Jalen Brunson is averaging 27 points and 5.9 assists for the Knicks. Towns is averaging 20.7 points and 14.1 rebounds while shooting 52.1% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Timberwolves: 8-2, averaging 114.8 points, 47.1 rebounds, 24.6 assists, 8.7 steals and 5.5 blocks per game while shooting 46.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 105.2 points per game. Knicks: 7-3, averaging 112.4 points, 47.4 rebounds, 27.1 assists, 7.1 steals and 4.2 blocks per game while shooting 45.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 103.3 points. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Zyon Pullin: day to day (quadriceps), Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), Jaylen Clark: out (hamstring), Jonathan Kuminga: day to day (shoulder), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). Knicks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
